---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL SnapshotProofTools == INSTANCE TLAPS

LEMMA SnapshotHistoryUnchanged ==
    (UNCHANGED ops) => (SnapshotIsolation' <=> SnapshotIsolation)
BY SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5") DEF SnapshotIsolation

SnapshotCommitAction == \E s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnCommit(s, tid)

LEMMA SnapshotNextHistory ==
    Next => ((UNCHANGED ops) \/ SnapshotCommitAction)
BY SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r15") DEF
    Next, SnapshotCommitAction,
    RouterTxnStart, RouterTxnOp, RouterTxnCoordinateCommit,
    RouterTxnCommitReadOnly, RouterTxnCommitSingleShard,
    ShardTxnStart, ShardTxnRead, ShardTxnWrite, ShardTxnCoordinateCommit,
    ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote, ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit,
    ShardTxnPrepare, ShardTxnAbort

LEMMA SnapshotNonCommitPreservation ==
    SnapshotIsolation /\ [Next]_vars /\ ~SnapshotCommitAction
        => SnapshotIsolation'
BY SnapshotHistoryUnchanged, SnapshotNextHistory,
   SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5") DEF vars

LEMMA SnapshotInitiallySingleWrite ==
    Init => SingleWritePerKey
PROOF
<1>1. DOMAIN <<>> = {}
    BY SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. Init => ops = [s \in TxId |-> <<>>]
    BY SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5") DEF Init
<1>3. Init => Range(ops) \subseteq {<<>>}
    BY <1>2, SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5") DEF Range
<1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>3, SnapshotProofTools!SMTT("r5") DEF
        SingleWritePerKey, WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM SnapshotIsolationCorrect ==
    (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) => []SnapshotIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1. Init => SingleWritePerKey
    BY SnapshotInitiallySingleWrite
<1>2. SnapshotIsolation /\ [Next]_vars /\ ~SnapshotCommitAction
         => SnapshotIsolation'
    BY SnapshotNonCommitPreservation
\* The final obligation is unresolved.  The current assumptions allow
\* NoValue = 100 and TxId = {1, 2, 3, 100}.  A one-shard history can be:
\*   1:   r(a,100), r(b,100), w(a,1)
\*   2:   r(a,100), r(b,100), w(b,2)
\*   100: r(a,1),   r(b,2),   w(a,100), w(b,100)
\*   3:   r(a,100), r(b,100), w(a,3)
\* Transactions 1 and 2 use timestamp 0 and commit at 1 and 2;
\* transactions 100 and 3 use timestamps 2 and 3 and commit at 3 and 4.
\* This satisfies SingleWritePerKey.  In the client-centric definition,
\* the only possible orders satisfying the read/value and NoConf tests
\* are (1,2,100,3) and (2,1,100,3).  Both have the initial state at parent
\* positions 1 and 4.  Index may choose position 4 for that state, since
\* it is defined by CHOOSE, not a minimum.  Then the second transaction
\* cannot use the initial state: beforeOrEqualInExecution requires 4 <= 2.
\* Selecting the greatest witness on finite sets of natural numbers is
\* a consistent choice interpretation.  Thus the missing final argument
\* cannot be supplied for all configurations allowed by the context.
<1> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, SnapshotProofTools!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
====
